Watt's Happening: UK Edition

Britain paid £1.5 billion last year to switch OFF wind farms.

Not a typo.

Scottish turbines get paid to stop spinning because the grid can't move the power south【6140506468247566745†L262-L264】. Then gas plants get paid to switch ON to replace it【6140506468247566745†L325-L326】.

Worst offender: Seagreen wind farm. Curtailed 2.7 TWh in 2025【6140506468247566745†L28-L29】. That's 740,000 homes' annual power, wasted.

Cost in 2024/25: £1.9bn = 71% of GB's total balancing bill【6140506468247566745†L13-L14】. Forecast 2030: £8bn/year【6140506468247566745†L25-L26】.

The fix? Batteries could cut curtailment costs 80%【6140506468247566745†L221-L223】. Bitcoin miners could buy the -$43/MWh power instead of paying to waste it.

Source: Modo Energy, The Times, Octopus Energy data.

Watt's Happening: Apr 18

3 Aus energy stories in 60 seconds:

1. AEMO: NSW solar curtailed 18% yesterday at noon. Price hit -$43/MWh. That's 1.2GWh of free energy with nowhere to go.

2. New 400MW/800MWh battery approved for Goulburn. Target ops 2027. Cost: $450M. 

3. Origin confirms Eraring coal plant still closing Aug 2025. “Extension unlikely” despite govt pressure.

Renewables made 74% of NSW grid power 11am-2pm. Coal: 9%.

Source: AEMO data dashboard.
